segments.text: This period concentrates on your 5th house of children, learning, creativity and romance. Rahu, the period's own planet, newly brings this area forward, since no other level touches it. It tends to show up as study or exam work, a creative project, a new attraction, or a willingness to take a financial gamble. Rahu shares Capricorn with Saturn, and The Brihat Jataka holds that Saturn there gives standing as head of a town, village or army

, so public responsibility may come alongside the personal matters.

Rahu sits in a trine to Mercury, so the two work together, and your Mercury sub-period is the fullest of the planets involved, which makes the support feel smooth. The Brihat Jataka ties Mercury in Taurus to a preacher's bent, generous giving, steady work to earn money, and respect for teachers, with many close partnerships
. Virgo rising, the book says, brings sweet speech and a bright appearance, though with a mixed temperament
. It also warns of a tight-fisted streak alongside wealth

sources.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius will enjoy the wives and property of other men, will be the head of a town, a village or an army,
A person born with Mercury in sign Taurus or Libra will be a preacher, will have many sons and wives, will ever be engaged in earning money, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.
6. A person born when the rising sign is Virgo, will be of sweet speech, of bright personal appearance, long legs and arms, will be of a mixed temperament, will be of excellent beauty,
[A person born when the rising sign is Virgo] will be rich, will be a niggard,
